known_issues: Admin button appears grey and loads indefinitely on the live webpage, indicating recurring connection problems.

existing_features.title: Diagnose and fix the root cause of the Admin button appearing permanently grey and spinning indefinitely on the live production site. The issue originates in the admin role detection logic (useIsCallerAdmin / useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout hooks) and/or the actor connection setup (useActor). The fix must ensure that: (a) the actor is fully initialised before the admin check is attempted, (b) any failed or stalled actor connection is detected and surfaced rather than silently hanging, and (c) the admin check resolves to a definitive result (admin / not-admin / error) within a reasonable timeout instead of remaining in a perpetual loading state.

Harden the actor initialisation in useActor so that connection failures are caught and exposed via a stable error state rather than leaving dependent hooks in a perpetual loading loop. Add a maximum wait threshold so that hooks that depend on the actor (such as admin role checks) can detect an unavailable actor and exit gracefully.

Update the Navigation component to handle the timed-out and error states returned by useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout: when a timeout or connection error occurs, hide the Admin button entirely (rather than showing it in a perpetual grey/loading state) and optionally display a subtle retry trigger.

projectName: Fix Admin button infinite loading / connection failure on live site
